description.text: Elective Courses: Calligraphy, Beijing Opera, Wushu, Shadowboxing, Chinese Painting, Two-stringed Chinese Fiddle, Chinese Folk Songs, Chinese Literature Appreciation, Computer Information Processing of Chinese Characters Mid-level Courses: Intensive Reading, Extensive Reading, Oral Chinese, Audio-visual Class, Chinese Grammar, Selected Reading of Chinese Newspaper Primary Courses: Intensive Reading, Oral Chinese, Listening, Writing Advanced Courses: Intensive Reading, Extensive Reading, Oral Chinese, Audio-visual Class, Chinese Grammar, Selected Reading of Chinese Newspaper Application Time: Students can apply any time of the year Starting Date: Spring Semester: September to January Duration: 1 semester to more

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Cours at Tianjin University of Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1.Graduation from high school (or the equivalent) 2.18 to 60 years of age
